prompt: In chess, one of your pawns battles all the way to the far end of the board. What happens?

options.text: It is removed from the board
It must turn around and head back
It is promoted, usually to a queen

explanation: A pawn that reaches the furthest rank is promoted — replaced by a queen, rook, bishop or knight of the same colour. Almost everyone chooses a queen, which is why this rule is often called 'queening'.
